Every action a CI workflow uses is pinned to a 40-hex commit SHA, its ref kept as a trailing comment (`WorkflowPinTest`) — keep it so.

| Layout | Taffy 0.15 (crates.io registry, resolved 0.15.1; a git dependency at a pinned rev until 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship; std, flexbox, flexbox_balance, grid, block_layout, content_size, calc, detailed_layout_info) via `stylo_taffy` |

This project was adopted into the Andromeda pipeline (`/andromeda-adopt` at `0f60502e`); its masters describe the code as built. Upstream DioxusLabs/blitz `main` was last merged at `23b9b26a9` (merge commit `3eda07bc`, 2026-10-17), the next sync's merge base; upstream `main` was last read at `ea07ee716`, three commits of that take taken by cherry-picks with the merge base unmoved and 112 left out with their measured reasons, its two behaviour changes for every document — the `@font-face` `font-stretch` read and the registry taffy 0.15.0 → 0.15.1 move — ratified; git Stylo 0.23-pre and Dioxus 0.8.0-alpha.3 wait for escher's next version, and the Taffy-main content comes through registry Taffy 0.15.x save #1303, which waits with the later git Taffy chain for its own chunk, so Stylo stays "0.22.0", Taffy the registry "0.15" and Dioxus "0.7.3".

Since the masters became rows, a row holds no line citation in its text, so a site-sweep pattern on `path.rs:N` never fires its control over them and reads nothing. But a row's `verified` metadata (`rec.py get` prints it under the cells) still quotes `at: {path}:{lines}` evidence from the tree it was verified on. Neither the citation sweep nor the cascade sweep reads that cell, so a chunk that moves code those lines name leaves the evidence pointing at the old lines with no tool flagging it. When a chunk restructures a file, read the rows its change-pattern hits with `rec.py get` and check their `verified` coordinates by hand; the report names any that moved. Extended 2026-11-15: the cell quotes values too, not only lines — a lockfile checksum a lock-only crate move changes — and no row operation rewrites it, so a stale quote found by hand is named in the report and the wrap's record until a re-verification of the masters rewrites the cell.

Engine behaviour change for every document, ratified by the founder: an @font-face rule's font-stretch (font-width) descriptor now reaches font matching beside family, weight and style.
Engine behaviour change for every document, ratified: the Taffy layout crate moves 0.15.0 to 0.15.1 from the crates.io registry, a lock-only move that brings 13 of upstream's 14 Taffy-main layout fixes. No package enters or leaves, and no manifest moves.
The WPT pinned commit moves, and the WPT timeout quarantine gains four dynamic-load-events entries.
The founder lifted the no-git-dependency rule for the Taffy crate alone. A later chunk takes git Taffy. No source of this chunk changes because of it.
Every gate is green, the a11y leg included. Test counts are unchanged on every OS, and no log site, endpoint, verb or carrier field was added.

body:
The eleventh upstream take: upstream/main read at ea07ee716, three upstream commits cherry-picked as written, 13 new commits left out with a measured reason each (112 left out in all).
The picks add the @font-face font-stretch (font-width) descriptor to the descriptors a web font is registered under, move the pinned WPT commit, and add four WPT timeout-quarantine entries with reason dynamic-load-events.
Taffy moves 0.15.0 to 0.15.1 by a lock-only, semver-compatible update from the crates.io registry; no manifest moves, no package enters or leaves, no git source enters the lock, and the audit reads advisories ok, licenses ok.
The git-Taffy take was measured green and not taken because of the no-git-dependency rule; the founder then ruled an exception to that rule for Taffy alone, and ratified both behaviour changes (the font-stretch read and the 0.15.1 layout fixes) for every document, remote pages included.
The lockfile's taffy entry now holds checksum 31f7bd2d97 (was 3c8480887e), and the source and checksum lines moved from 8040-8041 to 8042-8043.

body_fields.what: the lockfile, which holds every crate's resolved version, its registry source and its checksum; here the taffy entry (registry version 0.15.1, new checksum)
the engine's @font-face rule reader, which fetches web font sources from page CSS and registers each font under its CSS-declared descriptors (now family, weight, style and width)
the engine document, which applies the @font-face descriptor overrides when a fetched web font is registered for font matching
the pinned WPT commit the WPT runner reads its tests at
the WPT timeout-quarantine list, one entry a test path with a known reason, which the runner's validation test checks

body: decision/no-git-dependency: the founder ruled an exception for the taffy crate alone; the rule must now carry it (every other crate stays a registry version, and today no crate is a git source).

decision/no-git-dependencies: its rule takes the same Taffy-alone exception, and its verified evidence is stale: the quoted lockfile checksum moved from 3c8480887e to 31f7bd2d97 and the quoted range 8040-8041 no longer holds the source and checksum, which now stand at 8042-8043.
decision/engine-dependency-pins: Taffy stays the registry 0.15, now resolved 0.15.1; the row stays true but its Taffy pin is the one this session moved.

decision/upstream-sync-dependency-set: this take entered no package and moved a pinned crate by a lock-only, semver-compatible registry update that carries upstream's git-pinned content; the row's wording does not name that shape.
decision/wpt-quarantine-entries-valid: four new quarantine entries, each reason dynamic-load-events, a known reason, no path repeated; the rule holds for them.
decision/locked-builds: the lockfile moved (one crate's version and checksum); builds still read it locked.
decision/dependency-audit-ci-gate, decision/cargo-deny-audit-tool and decision/licence-gate: the audit leg read the moved lock green locally and in CI.
decision/workspace-inherited-dependency-versions: the taffy requirement in the manifest stays 0.15; only the resolved version moved.

decision/hintless-font-face-source-sniffed and decision/no-agent-urls-through-font-path: the @font-face rule reader they rule over now also reads the font-stretch descriptor from page CSS; it adds no URL and no fetch.
decision/untrusted-bytes-decoded-without-panic: page CSS now feeds one more @font-face descriptor (font-stretch, Stylo-parsed, numeric) into font matching for every document, remote pages included.
contract/wpt-results/timeout: four more tests sit in the timeout quarantine.

body_fields.fact: The no-git-dependency rule has one exception, ruled by the founder on 2026-11-15: the taffy crate alone may take a git source; every other crate stays a crates.io registry version, and a git Taffy, when taken, still passes the lock, audit and MSRV legs.

An upstream sync by cherry-pick may carry upstream's git-pinned crate content through a lock-only, semver-compatible registry update of an already-pinned crate, entering no package and moving no manifest.

The MCP server over stdio, its requests, results, protocol errors and tool-call span: unchanged.

The eleventh upstream take: upstream main read to ea07ee716, three upstream commits cherry-picked as upstream wrote them, thirteen new commits left out (112 left out in all), each with a measured reason.
The picks: blitz-dom now carries the @font-face font-stretch (font-width) descriptor into font matching as a new public width field on its font-face overrides; the WPT pinned commit moved; the WPT timeout quarantine gained four entries, each with reason dynamic-load-events.
taffy moved 0.15.0 to 0.15.1 from the crates.io registry, a lock-only semver-compatible update that brings 13 of the 14 Taffy-main commits; no manifest moved, no package entered or left, and the lock holds no git source.
The git-Taffy take was measured green and then left out under the no-git-dependency rule. The founder has since ruled an exception for Taffy alone to that rule, and a later chunk will move Taffy to git. The founder ratified both behaviour changes for every document (font-stretch read, taffy 0.15.1 layout fixes).
Every leg was green with no tally moved: fast 1461 passed, 0 failed, 13 ignored; stand 294/0/8; all 825/0/13; a11y, doc, msrv and audit green; fork CI 17/17, tallies +0 -0 in every job on linux, windows and macos.
On the founder's word, rdme and blitz (upstream demo shells that hold no tests) are stated outside the mutation tier's scope.

blitz-dom's document, which applies font-face overrides at font registration and holds the inline font_face_override_tests unit module and its fixture
the recorded WPT commit the conformance runner is pinned to
the WPT runner's timeout quarantine list, one test path and its known reason a line, skipped unless run-quarantined
the workspace lockfile the locked cargo legs build from, with registry sources and checksums (taffy now 0.15.1)

body: WPT pinned to a recorded commit: the pinned commit moved to bbb30d0f; the rule names the file, not the commit, so it should still hold. A picker checks any row that quotes the old commit 07e827e4.
WPT runner CLI run-quarantined and the WPT status TIMEOUT: four tests joined the timeout quarantine with the known reason dynamic-load-events, and no path repeats.

WPT conformance runner, WPT suites run in CI, WPT run on the host on the fork, and WPT conformance being report-only: the suite set they run moved with the new pin and the four newly quarantined tests.
WPT harness timeout multiplier: the four new entries are timeouts, quarantined rather than met by a larger multiplier.
Inline unit test modules and blitz-dom fixtures built without the HTML parser: the blitz-dom font-face override fixture now names width None, and no test exercises a non-None width.

Font-metric tests never skip, pre-existing font tests skip without a font, and font-dependent assertions on system fonts: font matching now also reads the @font-face width descriptor, a behaviour change for every document.

Layout assertions in both layout modes, stand checks run in both layout modes, and the incremental layout differential oracle: taffy 0.15.1's layout fixes reach every document, and both modes and the oracle stayed green with no count moved.
Local baseline for CI comparison and tally moves attributed by test name: the take's tallies read +0 -0 in every job against the base run.
Dependency audit (advisories and licenses): taffy's resolved version and checksum moved, and the audit read advisories ok, licenses ok.
Minimum supported Rust version and MSRV verified by build only: taffy 0.15.1 declares rust-version 1.71, and the msrv leg stayed green.
Cargo legs run locked: the lockfile moved by a lock-only update (taffy 0.15.0 to 0.15.1), and no manifest moved.
Clippy over the workspace and upstream blitz-dom: upstream blitz-dom gained a public field and two construction sites, and clippy stayed green.
Upstream tests kept as written or left out: this take's upstream tests rule over the picks. No upstream test came with the picks, and upstream added no width test.

Mutation testing on the dev host, mutation runs on the dev host only, mutation baseline read per unit, and mutation baseline skipped: rdme and blitz are now stated outside the mutation tier's scope (no tests, baseline-test-failure skips), while churn, sizes and the other collectors keep both.
Per-crate line coverage floors and coverage floor per crate: blitz-dom gained a font-stretch read path with no non-None test. A picker flags only a row whose floor cell holds a blitz-dom value.
blitz-dom builds requests through one stamping constructor: blitz-dom's net module changed, though only its font-face descriptor read, not how it builds requests.

body_fields.fact: The mutation tier does not run rdme (apps/readme) or blitz (packages/blitz): both are upstream demo shells holding no tests, so no test is owed them for the mutation tier; churn, sizes and the other collectors keep both.
